description: Real pinned CVA6 (cva6, cv64a6_imafdc_sv39) as the single unified AXI4 memory master of a 64-bit fabric, with a boot ROM at its declared reset vector and one RAM region. The AXI4 boundary is the packed struct pair noc_req_o/noc_resp_i, so this request is what exercises the composer's member-wise struct-port binding, rendering and audit. No peripheral is composed: every peripheral profile in this repository is a 32-bit target, and a 64-to-32 width conversion is refused by the renderer (width-adapter-rendering-unsupported) rather than silently skipped, so the honest end-to-end composition of this CPU is CPU plus memory.
